reason: The only visible action is to connect the cylinders to the processor's carbon-dioxide outlet.
expectation: The cylinders should collect carbon dioxide from the processor.

effect: The cylinder collected carbon dioxide while the breathing-oxygen line continued running, completing the chapter and identifying the second methane ingredient.
reaction: The separate takeoff was a useful detail, though the action itself was predictable.

mostWorthwhile.text: Collecting carbon dioxide was worthwhile for its explanation of how the existing processor supplies a fuel ingredient without interrupting oxygen production.

leastWorthwhile.text: The chapter offered only one visible action, so there was little opportunity for a meaningful decision.

surprise.text: I learned that the carbon dioxide is taken off before it reaches the oxygen-making cell while the breathing-oxygen line keeps running.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary: connecting a gas cylinder to the carbon-dioxide outlet had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how the collected gas becomes return fuel, although this chapter alone offered little gameplay variety.
